callRouteVisualizer.title: Call Routing
callRouteVisualizer.pickSomething: Pick a number or callflow on the left to see where its calls go.
callRouteVisualizer.loadFailed: Could not load this account's call routing.
callRouteVisualizer.simHint: Pick when the call comes in. The path it takes lights up — press keys on a menu's keypad to choose.
callRouteVisualizer.simNeedsStart: Pick one number or callflow — or click a number on the map — to simulate a call to it.
callRouteVisualizer.nowHint: Set the date and time to right now
callRouteVisualizer.currentOnly: Hide routes this call doesn't take
callRouteVisualizer.liveHint: Uses each phone's real status right now: users whose phones are all offline don't answer.
callRouteVisualizer.noAudio: Audio playback is not available here.
callRouteVisualizer.exportHint: Opens a print view — choose "Save as PDF" to share it with someone who can't log in.
